result.question: What was Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024?
result.answer: Apple's total net sales for fiscal year 2024 were $391,035 million (approximately $391.0 billion), for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. This figure is corroborated by the XBRL fact filed with the SEC, which reports Net sales of 391,035,000,000 USD for FY 2024 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2024-09-28], and by the press release accompanying the 10-K, which also shows total net sales of $391,035 million for the twelve months ended September 28, 2024 [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. The total was composed of Products net sales of $294,866 million and Services net sales of $96,169 million [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. This represented an approximately 2% increase from fiscal year 2023's total net sales of $383,285 million [0000320193-24-000123:item-7-p001]. Fiscal year 2024 spanned 52 weeks, ending on September 28, 2024 [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p004].
